validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="">
  <state id="a" initial=" ">
    <state id="a1"><transition event="go" target="a2"/></state>
    <state id="a2"><transition event="go" target="done"/></state>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

notes: an `initial` attribute lists the states entered first; an empty list enters nothing, so the compiler rejects it (omit the attribute to enter the first child state)
diagnostics.help: name the initial state, or remove `initial` to enter the first child state in document order
